name: gizza-ai/lsb-embed
summary: Hide a secret message inside an image (LSB steganography).

tool.description: Hide a secret text message inside an image using LSB (least-significant-bit) steganography and return a stego PNG that looks identical to the original. Set bits_per_channel 1-4 (default 1; higher hides more text but is slightly more visible). The output is always a lossless PNG so the hidden data survives. Provide the carrier image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

message.description: The secret text to hide inside the image.

bits_per_channel.description: Low bits to use per colour channel, 1-4 (default 1). Higher hides more text but is more visible.
